examples.en: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety.
examples.zh: 美国人愿意忍受耗时的安全程序，来换取更高的安全性。

examples.en: The complaints procedure is clumsy and time-consuming.
Going to court can be an expensive, time-consuming, and gut-wrenching experience that is best avoided.
examples.zh: 上法庭会是种费钱，费时间，并带来精神痛苦的经历，最好能加以避免。
